body: Turn any PDF or image document into structured data for your AI. A powerful, lightweight OCR toolkit that bridges the gap between images/PDFs and LLMs. Supports 100+ languages.
plain_description: The big picture: PaddleOCR converts any PDF or image into clean, structured data your AI systems can use immediately. Why it matters: No more manual data entry or complex document workflows — just feed in documents and get JSON or Markdown output ready for RAG, AI agents, and automation. The bottom line: With 100+ language support and deep integration with Dify, RAGFlow, and other platforms, it's the fastest way to make your documents AI-ready.
technical_description: PaddleOCR is a lightweight OCR toolkit and document AI engine for converting PDFs and images into structured JSON or Markdown output. It provides a modular pipeline architecture supporting text detection, recognition, layout analysis, table extraction, formula recognition, and seal detection across 100+ languages. The project includes multiple model series: PP-OCRv6 for universal scene text recognition (50 languages, single model), PaddleOCR-VL for vision-language document parsing (0.9B parameters, 96.3% accuracy), and PP-StructureV3 for structure-aware document conversion with fine-grained element coordinates. Deployment options include Python SDK, Docker containers, C++ inference, REST API serving via hubserving, Android/iOS mobile runtimes, and browser inference via PaddleOCR.js. Models can be exported to ONNX format and accelerated using OpenVINO, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime on CPU, NVIDIA GPU, or Apple Silicon.
title: PaddleOCR
